name: EDGAR Scrubber (424B2 structured notes)
purpose: Exploratory extraction of 424B2 structured-note terms into a LOCAL tool store — never a pipeline write. A field stays local only while a Research project is exploring it; when it proves out it graduates upstream and the local extractor is retired (#95/#109).

name: Free Research (open-ended filing briefs)
purpose: Pull raw filings into a LOCAL store, then fill a brief template from them with a local model — no field spec written in advance, and no metered API spend. A slot whose value cannot be checked against the pulled rows is dropped and reported, so what survives is auditable against the rows sitting next to it (#147/#152).

name: Magic Formula Rank
purpose: Greenblatt composite: rank(ROIC) + rank(EBIT/EV) among screener-eligible names → a single quality-value rank.

name: Smart Money Score
purpose: Congress + insider + news-sentiment composite → a signed conviction score per ticker. Out-of-sample validation still pending (#47), so it reads as a candidate signal, not a promoted one.

name: Dealer-Hedging Barrier Causal Test
purpose: Propensity-matches elevated- vs low-issuance underlyings on size/ADV/options-OI and tests forward realized-vol/barrier-pinning behavior; calibrates the confirm/refute bar empirically against placebo null universes rather than an independence-assuming chance floor (#131).
